text:
The diff moves the port to VLAN 212, not VLAN 210 as the ticket states. The test plan below uses `like` to check that stage-b1 matches web-b1, plus reachability checks that would fail if the wrong VLAN is in place.

```json
{"tests": [
  {"t":"like","host":"stage-b1","as":"web-b1"},

  {"t":"reach","src":"wan-user1","dst":"stage-b1","svc":"tcp/443","expect":"allow"},
  {"t":"reach","src":"wan-user1","dst":"stage-b1","svc":"tcp/80","expect":"allow"},
  {"t":"reach","src":"wan-user1","dst":"stage-b1","svc":"tcp/22","expect":"deny"},
  {"t":"reach","src":"wan-user1","dst":"stage-b1","svc":"tcp/5432","expect":"deny"},

  {"t":"reach","src":"stage-b1","dst":"dns-dc1","svc":"udp/53","expect":"allow"},
  {"t":"reach","src":"stage-b1","dst":"db-b1","svc":"tcp/5432","expect":"allow"},
  {"t":"reach","src":"stage-b1","dst":"db-a1","svc":"*","expect":"deny"},
  {"t":"reach","src":"stage-b1","dst":"web-a1","svc":"*","expect":"deny"},
  {"t":"reach","src":"stage-b1","dst":"backup1","svc":"*","expect":"unchanged"},
  {"t":"reach","src":"noc1","dst":"stage-b1","svc":"tcp/22","expect":"allow"},
  {"t":"reach","src":"noc1","dst":"stage-b1","svc":"icmp","expect":"allow"},

  {"t":"reach","src":"web-b1","dst":"stage-b1","svc":"*","expect":"allow"},
  {"t":"reach","src":"stage-a1","dst":"stage-b1","svc":"*","expect":"deny"},
  {"t":"reach","src":"web-a1","dst":"stage-b1","svc":"*","expect":"deny"},
  {"t":"reach","src":"db-b1","dst":"stage-b1","svc":"*","expect":"unchanged"},

  {"t":"reach","src":"stage-b1","dst":"stage-a1","svc":"*","expect":"deny"},
  {"t":"reach","src":"stage-b1","dst":"app-a1","svc":"*","expect":"deny"},
  {"t":"reach","src":"stage-b1","dst":"wan-user1","svc":"*","expect":"unchanged"},

  {"t":"path","src":"stage-b1","dst":"web-b1","via":"leaf4","expect":true},

  {"t":"mtu","src":"stage-b1","dst":"web-b1","size":9000,"expect":"pass"},
  {"t":"mtu","src":"stage-b1","dst":"db-b1","size":9000,"expect":"pass"},
  {"t":"mtu","src":"stage-b1","dst":"wan-user1","size":1500,"expect":"pass"},

  {"t":"adj","a":"leaf4","b":"spine1","expect":"unchanged"},
  {"t":"adj","a":"leaf4","b":"spine2","expect":"unchanged"},
  {"t":"route","dev":"leaf4","prefix":"10.201.1.0/24","expect":"present"},
  {"t":"route","dev":"leaf4","prefix":"10.201.2.0/24","expect":"unchanged"}
]}
```

**Note for the reviewer:** the diff sets `switchport access vlan 212`, but the ticket and the target subnet 10.201.1.0/24 imply VLAN 210. The `like` test and the reachability tests against web-b1's access profile should fail on the current diff. If they pass, VLAN 212 is mapped to the same policy as 210, which should be confirmed explicitly before approval.
